subject: _app/components/ ships ContentCatalog.js.<timestamp>.bak files -- at least 9 of them -- and _app IS the served public directory (firebase.json public: _app). They are publicly fetchable stale copies of the content catalog. Not a credential leak, but they are served bytes nobody intends to serve and they pollute every grep for catalog references (they matched during the orphan audit 2026-08-01). Archive them out of _app.
description:
Found 2026-08-01
[2026-08-01 00:40] CORRECTION -- my original premise was WRONG and I checked it only after writing it. These are NOT publicly fetchable: firebase.json hosting.ignore contains '**/*.bak', '**/*.bak.*' and '**/*.*.bak', and a live fetch of one returns HTTP 404. They are also gitignored (.gitignore:55 '*.bak'), so never tracked or deployed. Real count is 291, not 9. The ONLY genuine issue left is grep pollution -- they matched during the 2026-08-01 orphan audit and made a dead quiz look like it had inbound references. Downgrade to housekeeping: archive them out of _app/components/ so local searches stop hitting them. No security or serving impact.
